newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Casinos Austria to receive A$18 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Casinos Austria to receive A$18 mln.

text.p: Casinos Austria International Ltd said on Thursday it would receive an A$18.0 million capital injection from its parent company Casinos Austria Internnational Holding GmbH.

Casinos Austria International (CAI) said the capital injection would be through a placement of 25.7 million shares at 70 cents per share which would see CAI's issued capital increase to 175.7 million shares.
CAI said its parent's holding in the company would rise to 61.5 percent from 54.9 percent.
CAI chief executive Alex Tucek said in a statement that A$12 million of the capital injection would be used to reduce debt at Casino Canberra, a CAI managed casino, to A$13 million from A$25 million.

CAI said the remaining A$6 million would be available for working capital and current company projects, including the Great Blue Heron Casino, located just outside Toronto, Canada, which is due to be opened in December 1996.
CAI shares closed 2.5 cents lower at 40 cents.
